title: Different interventions address different error slices
method: Synthetic set: 40 policy-fact cases and 60 classification cases. Totals are 20+42, 34+44, and 22+54 respectively. Interventions are evaluated separately; combined performance cannot be inferred by adding gains.
alt: Different interventions address different error slices. Baseline: 62 passed cases out of 100, Retrieval added: 78 passed cases out of 100, Classifier adapted: 76 passed cases out of 100. Illustrative data.
